title: Student Health Clinic Services
content: The Campus Student Health Clinic is located in the Central Block, Ground Floor. It provides free primary care, immunizations, basic first aid, and standard consultations for all enrolled students. The clinic is open Monday to Friday from 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM. No appointment is needed for walk-in triage, but scheduling is recommended for routine checkups.

title: Campus Counselling and Psychological Services
content: The Campus Counselling Center is situated in the Administrative Block, 2nd Floor. Licensed counselors offer free, confidential individual sessions, support groups, and mental health resources to help students cope with academic pressure, relationships, or personal challenges. Appointments can be booked online or via phone extension 108.

title: Campus Health Contacts & Details
content:
Campus Health Services contact directory:
- Main Clinic Desk: Ext 107
- Counselling Center: Ext 108
- Emergency Medical Services (24/7): Ext 911 (Located in Central Block, Ground Floor, open 24/7 for medical emergencies).
